title: Blow-up convergence ⇒ lower ball-mass bound c·t^n ≤ μ(B_t(x)) for c < θω_n
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on Euclidean N, x ∈ Euclidean N, T ∈ G(N,n) and θ ∈ ℝ with θ > 0. Assume that for every g ∈ C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), t⁻¹^n ∫ g(t⁻¹ • (z − x)) dμ(z) → θ ∫_{T.plane} g dμHE[n] as t → 0⁺. Then for every c ∈ [0, ∞] with c < ENNReal.ofReal(θ) · unitBallVolume n, eventually as t → 0⁺ we have c · ENNReal.ofReal(t)^n ≤ μ(closedBall x t).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ → (∀ g : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, g (t⁻¹ • (z - x)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n]))) → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < ENNReal.ofReal θ * unitBallVolume n → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), c * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall x t)
